```

---

**The folder layout for a new project (ESP32 example):**
```
Projects/
  030_ESP32_Sensor/
    project.cfg          ← change: project name, source dirs
    CMakeLists.txt       ← change: sources, includes
    CMakePresets.json    ← change: preset name
    cmake/
      toolchain.cmake    ← change: xtensa compiler flags
    Dockerfile           ← change: espidf toolchain block
    Makefile             ← DO NOT TOUCH (copy verbatim)
    tools/               ← DO NOT TOUCH (copy verbatim)
    Core/
      ...your source...
